statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
The denial reason is PR-204, indicating the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Continuous external cardiac monitoring is medically necessary to detect clinically significant events that may require intervention
